name: Test: Virtual Log (2000 lines)
description: Generates 2000 log lines to trigger VirtualLogPane (threshold: 500 lines). Compare scrolling performance vs a normal <pre> with 2000 lines.

nodes.name: Flood 2000 Log Lines
nodes.instructions: for i in $(seq 1 2000); do echo "[line $i] Processing batch item — status=ok elapsed=${i}ms payload=$(head -c 80 /dev/urandom | base64 | head -c 60)"; done

nodes.name: Small Output (10 lines)
nodes.instructions: for i in $(seq 1 10); do echo "Normal log line $i"; done

nodes.name: Done
nodes.instructions: echo 'Virtual log test complete. The 2000-line node should use virtualized scrolling, the 10-line node should use plain <pre>.'
